title: Wesbank (Reindeer St, approx.): boy, 14, shot dead, teen wounded, 10 Oct
summary: Mfuleni police responded to a shooting in Reindeer Street, Wesbank, at about 20:10 on Saturday 10 October: Lincoln Jonathan, 14, a Grade 8 learner at Silversands High School, died at the scene and a Grade 11 learner was ...
story: Mfuleni police responded to a shooting in Reindeer Street, Wesbank, at about 20:10 on Saturday 10 October: Lincoln Jonathan, 14, a Grade 8 learner at Silversands High School, died at the scene and a Grade 11 learner was wounded (TygerBurger, 12 Oct, quoting police spokesperson Wesley Twigg).
incident: Sat 10 Oct 2026, about 20:10 (police, TygerBurger 12 Oct). TygerBurger's follow-up of 13 Oct wrongly says 17 October.
location_note: Corner of Reindeer Street, Wesbank (exact spot not given). OpenStreetMap has it as Reindeer Crescent; the pin is on it.
basis: Two reports from one outlet; the date comes from the police statement in the first.
disagreements: TygerBurger's 13 Oct follow-up says Saturday 17 October, which is after it was published; its 12 Oct report quotes police giving Saturday 10 October.

other_voices: School Facebook post quoted by TygerBurger
provenance.note: Two reports from one paper by the same reporter. Police facts, education department and a school post quoted by that outlet; not separately obtained independent reporting.
